nodes.label: Arena mode («Арена»)
nodes.rationale: Separate mode beside races focused on maximum-speed driving and cornering; one 'To battle' button and 3-4 min matches suit the small Yandex Games audience; bots now, balanced for future PvP.

nodes.label: NPC turrets (турели НПС)
nodes.rationale: Optional turrets on ruins near camping spots that escalate accuracy (no lead early, full lead at the end) rather than damage; destructible, respawn ~30 s; recommended 1-2 or none.

nodes.label: Bridge bomb (бомба с моста)
nodes.rationale: Bomb can only be dropped while jumping between bridges over the canyon to hit several cars below; the fire button becomes the bomb in mid-air (no extra phone button); ~2 s red shadow telegraph lets alert players escape; diminishing points for multi-kills.

nodes.label: Cloverleaf canyon dune map («клевер»)
nodes.rationale: Post-apocalyptic dune with a huge central canyon crossed by collapsed cloverleaf bridges, 5-6 ramps up and 9-10 descents; ~600 m across so rivals meet roughly every 10 s at 120 km/h, replacing the 100×100 m box crossed in 3 s.

nodes.label: Final 30 s double points (финал ×2)
nodes.rationale: Last 30 s award ×2 points to escalate the finale without shrinking the play area.

nodes.label: NPC plane raids (налёты самолётов НПС)
nodes.rationale: Main escalation instead of a shrinking zone: strafing runs, chasing bombs and a final carpet raid, all telegraphed and escapable without braking; never over the canyon so the centre belongs to players; shares one bomb system with the bridge bomb.

nodes.label: Nuke charge event with rock-gap sectors (ядерный заряд)
nodes.rationale: Nuke is a timed event every 60-90 s, not an ability, so one jump cannot decide the match; drop accuracy decides how many rock gaps (canyon exits) the core pierces; 5 s siren window to reach shadow; dropper must land and hide too; capped fixed bonus.
nodes.norm_label: nuke charge event with rock-gap sectors (ядерныи заряд)

nodes.label: Sandstorm finale (песчаная буря)
nodes.rationale: Optional 30 s finale only if the ending lacks tension.

nodes.label: Ugar multiplier («Угар»)
nodes.rationale: ×1..×3 multiplier for reckless fast driving, grown by speed × lateral load, completed drift stages, hits and high-speed rams; not decayed by braking into a slide (skill, not camping), decays on long slow driving; speed or shooting alone cannot farm it. Whether it multiplies all shares is open.

nodes.label: Environment kill credit
nodes.rationale: Kills by plane bombs, traps or the abyss go to the last player who dealt damage within 5 s, otherwise nobody.

nodes.label: Fast loops around the canyon (быстрые петли)
nodes.rationale: 2-3 wide fast loops with long arcs crossing at the bridges keep an open map high-speed and double as bot route network; bumpers instead of walls preserve speed.
nodes.norm_label: fast loops around the canyon (быстрые петли)

nodes.label: Five-share scoring (пять равных долей)
nodes.rationale: Score = speed, hits, kills, centre proximity, longest life, ~200 each; caps farming any single source so circling alone yields at most ~1/5 and cannot win.

nodes.label: Graduated longest-life bonus
nodes.rationale: Proportional to longest streak without death instead of yes/no: a binary bonus makes the leader camp and an early death loses the share for the whole match. Open question.

nodes.label: Not-a-snitch winner rule («не снитч из квиддича»)
nodes.rationale: Most points wins; surviving is only a bonus, not an automatic win, because last-man-standing rewards camping.
nodes.norm_label: not-a-snitch winner rule («не снитч из квиддича»)

nodes.label: Respawn in motion (респаун в движении)
nodes.rationale: Always respawn ~1.5 s later already moving at ~80 km/h with brief invulnerability removed by first shot; no elimination phase, no point penalty, so fear of loss does not create cautious play.

nodes.label: Precomputed shadow sectors (секторы тени)
nodes.rationale: Shelter behind mountains is pre-marked angular sectors from the centre instead of physics raycasts: deterministic for multiplayer and cheap for WebGL.

nodes.label: Shrinking zone (сужающаяся зона, rejected)
nodes.rationale: Rejected: a cramped finale kills high-speed driving; replaced by NPC air raids.

nodes.label: Simulation-tick determinism rule
nodes.rationale: Score, Ugar, raids, bombs and shadow sectors run in the SimulationStep tick, not Update, with deterministic NPC targeting, for future multiplayer; every environmental death telegraphed.

nodes.label: Timed ruin traps (ловушки по времени)
nodes.rationale: Traps in ruins trigger from time spent inside (creak at 3 s, collapse at 5 s), not randomly, so driving through is safe but hiding is punished.
